'''Alexander Ilyin''' ({{langx|ru|Алекса́ндр Влади́мирович Ильи́н}}, (born January 11, 1973) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr. Sc.]], a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]], [[Corresponding Member]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://isaran.ru/?guid=B0106354-7919-CB09-265E-9AFA85F603C7&q=ru/person|title=Ильин Александр Владимирович. &#124; ИС АРАН|website=isaran.ru}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?option_lang=rus&personid=41758|title=Персоналии: Ильин Александр Владимирович|website=www.mathnet.ru}}</ref> Expert in [[robust control]] theory.

He defended the thesis «Robust inversion of dynamic systems» for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (2009).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://ndsipu.cmc.msu.ru/teachers.php?id=107|title=Ильин Александр Владимирович &#124; Кафедра НДСиПУ|website=ndsipu.cmc.msu.ru}}</ref>

He has authored four books and more than 90 scientific articles.<ref name="istina">{{cite web |url=https://istina.msu.ru/profile/iline@cs.msu.su/ |title=Ильин Александр Владимирович - пользователь, сотрудник &#124; ИСТИНА – Интеллектуальная Система Тематического Исследования НАукометрических данных |trans-title=Ilyin Alexander Vladimirovich &#124; Intellectual System of the Thematic Research of NAUmetric data " |website=istina.msu.ru |accessdate=2018-05-22}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?&personid=41758&option_lang=eng|title=Persons: Il'in, Aleksandr Vladimirovich|website=www.mathnet.ru}}</ref>

He is the son of famed mathematician [[Vladimir Ilyin (mathematician)|Vladimir Ilyin]].
